# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Gather all relevant documentation related to the product.
3. Identify and list the advertised specifications.
4. Perform accurate and repeatable tests.
5. Document all testing procedures used.
6. Record the conditions under which the tests were conducted.
7. Record any statistical analysis performed.
8. Compare test results with advertised specifications.
9. List discrepancies between test results and advertised performance.
10. Explain the methods used to measure each advertised specification.
11. Detail the equipment and tools used in testing.
12. Describe any environmental factors that could have influenced the test results.
13. List any assumptions made in the testing process.
14. Provide a detailed explanation of why the product did not meet its advertised specifications.
15. Include photographs, charts, and any other visual aids that can support the findings.
16. Review the report for clarity and completeness before submission.
17. Obtain peer reviews or a second opinion on the findings and documentation.
